item.title: Anthropic Denies It Could Sabotage AI Tools During War
item.description: The Department of Defense alleges the AI developer could manipulate models in the middle of war. Company executives argue that’s impossible.

item.title: There Aren’t a Lot of Reasons to Get Excited About a New Amazon Smartphone
item.description: The company is reportedly building a new AI-powered mobile device. If Amazon follows through on the plan, experts warn it would be next to impossible to break into a crowded market.

item.title: Gamers Hate Nvidia's DLSS 5. Developers Aren’t Crazy About It, Either
item.description: Nvidia’s new AI upscaling gaming technology struck gamers as uncanny and off-putting. Developers don't seem to like it, either, but it could be “the default” in a few years.

item.title: At Palantir’s Developer Conference, AI Is Built to Win Wars
item.description: As business soars, Palantir is doubling down on a vision of AI built for battlefield advantage—and attracting customers who agree.

item.title: I Learned More Than I Thought I Would From Using Food-Tracking Apps
item.description: These apps, some of which use AI and computer vision, were helpful for meeting my caloric and nutrition intake goals. But they also gave me some anxiety.

item.title: My AI Agent ‘Cofounder’ Conquered LinkedIn. Then It Got Banned
item.description: When social media is constantly pushing people to use AI, why not let AI agents participate?

item.title: ‘Uncanny Valley’: Nvidia’s ‘Super Bowl of AI,’ Tesla Disappoints, and Meta’s VR Metaverse ‘Shutdown’
item.description: In this episode, we dive into Nvidia’s annual developer conference and what CEO Jensen Huang is saying about the future of the company.

item.title: Google Shakes Up Its Browser Agent Team Amid OpenClaw Craze
item.description: As Silicon Valley obsesses over a new wave of AI coding agents, Google and other AI labs are shifting their bets.

item.title: ChatGPT’s ‘Adult Mode’ Could Spark a New Era of Intimate Surveillance
item.description: OpenAI plans to allow sexting with ChatGPT. A human-AI interaction expert warns of a privacy nightmare.

item.title: Signal’s Creator Is Helping Encrypt Meta AI
item.description: Moxie Marlinspike says the technology powering his encrypted AI chatbot, Confer, will be integrated into Meta AI. The move could help protect the AI conversations of millions of people.
